questions.stem:
$$8x+y=-11$$
$$2x^2=y+341$$

The graphs of the equations in the given system of equations intersect at the point $(x,y)$ in the $xy$-plane. What is a possible value of $x$?
Function $f$ is defined as $f(x)=(2x-5)^2$, and function $g$ is defined as $g(x)=2(2x+7)$. Which of the following is equivalent to $f(x)+g(x)$?
A right circular cone has a volume of $\dfrac{1}{3}\pi$ cubic feet and a height of $9$ feet. What is the radius, in feet, of the base of the cone?

$$\dfrac{3}{2}y-\dfrac{1}{4}x=\dfrac{2}{3}-\dfrac{3}{2}y$$
$$\dfrac{1}{2}x+\dfrac{3}{2}=py+\dfrac{9}{2}$$

In the given system of equations, $p$ is a constant. If the system has no solution, what is the value of $p$?

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|}\hline x & y \\ \hline -6 & n+184 \\ \hline -3 & n+92 \\ \hline 0 & n \\ \hline\end{array}$$

The table shows three values of $x$ and their corresponding values of $y$, where $n$ is a constant, for the linear relationship between $x$ and $y$. What is the slope of the line that represents this relationship in the $xy$-plane?
$(x + 4)(x - 14) = 0$ What is the positive solution to the given equation?

According to data provided by the US Department of Energy, the average price per gallon of regular gasoline in the United States from September 1, 2014, to December 1, 2014, is modeled by the function $F$ defined below, where $F(x)$ is the average price per gallon $x$ months after September 1.

$$F(x)=2.74-0.19(x-3)$$

The constant $2.74$ in this function estimates which of the following?

options.A: The average monthly decrease in the price per gallon
options.B: The difference in the average price per gallon from September 1, 2014, to December 1, 2014
options.C: The average price per gallon on September 1, 2014
options.D: The average price per gallon on December 1, 2014

questions.stem:
The function shown gives the total cost $f(x)$, in dollars, for making $x$ units of a certain product.

$f(x)=4x+900$

What is the total cost, in dollars, for making 100 units of this product?
The total mass, in kilograms, of $r$ identical objects is $t$. Which expression represents the total mass, in kilograms, of $146r$ of these objects?

A statistician conducted a study to investigate the relationship between the average number of minutes piano students practiced each week and the percentage of correct notes the students played during a recital. For the study, the statistician selected a sample of $85$ piano students at random from all the piano students in a certain region who were in their second year with their conservatory. The table shows the information for the $75$ piano students in this sample who practiced at least $50$ minutes on average each week.

Percentage of correct notes the students played during a recital
$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Average number of minutes practiced each week} & \text{Less than } 50\% & 50\% \text{ to } 80\% & \text{Greater than } 80\% & \text{Total}\\\hline 50 \text{ to } 150 & 7 & 28 & 5 & 40\\\hline 151 \text{ or more} & 3 & 11 & 21 & 35\\\hline \text{Total} & 10 & 39 & 26 & 75\\\hline\end{array}$$

Which of the following is the largest population to which the results of the study can be generalized?

options.A: All piano students who were in their second year with their conservatory
options.B: All piano students in the region
options.C: All piano students in the region who were in their second year with their conservatory
options.D: The $75$ piano students in the sample who practiced at least $50$ minutes on average each week

questions.stem:
The table gives the volumes of two similar right circular cylinders. Cylinder A has volume $72\pi$ cubic units, and cylinder B has volume $4608\pi$ cubic units.

The table shows the volume of two similar solids, right circular

cylinder A and right circular cylinder B. The radius of right

circular cylinder A is 3 units. The surface area of right circular

cylinder A is $k\pi$ square units, and the surface area of right circular

cylinder B is $n\pi$ square units, where $k$ and $n$ are constants. What

is the value of $n - k$? (The surface area of a right circular cylinder

with radius $r$ and height $h$ is $2\pi r^2 + 2\pi rh$.)

figures.alt: A table with two rows: Cylinder A, volume 72pi; Cylinder B, volume 4608pi (cubic units).

questions.stem:
Which of the following expressions is(are) a factor of $5x^2+$ $22x-48$?

I. $x-6$ II. $5x-8$

To earn a certificate of completion for a training program, participants are required to complete at least 120 training hours. If a participant has completed 44 training hours, what is the minimum number of additional training hours the participant is required to complete to earn the certificate of completion?
The ratio 72 to $m$ is equivalent to the ratio 4 to 24. What is the value of $m$?

A manager is responsible for ordering supplies for a shaved ice shop. The shop's inventory starts with 4,500 paper cups, and the manager estimates that 70 of these paper cups are used each day. Based on this estimate, in how many days will the supply of paper cups reach 1,700?
Which expression is equivalent to $42x^3+7x$?

Right rectangular prism X is similar to right rectangular prism Y. The surface area of right rectangular prism X is $55$ square centimeters (cm$^2$), and the surface area of right rectangular prism Y is $880$ cm$^2$. The volume of right rectangular prism Y is $1{,}600$ cubic centimeters (cm$^3$). What is the sum of the volumes, in cm$^3$, of right rectangular prism X and right rectangular prism Y?

The bar graph shows the distribution of the number of walnuts per container for 20 containers at a grocery store.

How many of these containers of walnuts contain exactly 78 walnuts?

figures.alt: Vertical bar graph. Y-axis labelled Frequency, 0 to 8 in steps of 1. X-axis labelled Number of walnuts per container with categories 75, 76, 77, 78. Bar heights: 75 = 2, 76 = 5, 77 = 6, 78 = 7.

questions.stem:
$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}\hline & \text{Human Resources} & \text{Accounting}\\\hline \text{Bachelor’s degree} & 4 & 3\\\hline \text{Master’s degree} & 2 & 6\\\hline\end{array}$$

The table above shows the number of people who work in the Human Resources and Accounting departments of a company and the highest level of education they have completed. A person from one of these departments is to be chosen at random. If the person chosen works in the Human Resources department, what is the probability that the highest level of education the person completed is a master’s degree?

At different times on a certain day, a manager at a theme park recorded the number of visitors. An exponential model gives the estimated number of visitors, $V$, at the theme park $t$ hours after the theme park opened, where $t \le 3$. Based on the model, $85$ visitors were estimated to be at the theme park when it opened, and every $30$ minutes the estimated number of visitors increased by $120\%$ of the estimated number of visitors $30$ minutes earlier. Which of the following equations best represents this model?

In isosceles triangle $ABC$, sides $AB$ and $AC$ are congruent. Point $D$ divides side $BC$ such that the length of $BD$ is $\frac{2}{7}$ of the length of $BC$. Point $E$ lies on side $AB$ and point $F$ lies on side $AC$ such that when segments $DE$ and $DF$ are drawn, angle $BED$ is congruent to angle $CFD$. If the length of $BE$ is $14$, what is the length of $CF$?

The table shows the distribution of rooms in a certain facility by seating capacity.

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|}\hline \text{Seating capacity} & \text{Proportion}\\\hline \text{Less than } 18 \text{ seats} & 26\%\\\hline 18\text{-}40 \text{ seats} & 21\%\\\hline 41\text{-}65 \text{ seats} & 29\%\\\hline \text{Greater than } 65 \text{ seats} & 24\%\\\hline\end{array}$$
If a room in this facility is selected at random, which of the following is closest to the probability of selecting a room that has a seating capacity greater than $65$ seats, given that the room has a seating capacity of at least $18$ seats?

The function $P$ defined by $P(t)=19.5(1.036)^t$ gives the predicted population, in millions, of a certain country for the period from 1984 to 2018, where $t$ is the number of years after 1984. According to this function, what is the best interpretation of the statement $P(7)$ is approximately equal to $24.98$?

options.A: In 1984, the predicted population of this country was approximately 7 million.
options.B: In 1984, the predicted population of this country was approximately 24.98 million.
options.C: 24.98 years after 1984, the predicted population of this country was approximately 7 million.
options.D: 7 years after 1984, the predicted population of this country was approximately 24.98 million.

questions.stem: If $x\geq -8$ represents all solutions to the inequality $ax-12\leq 36$, where $a$ is a constant, what is the greatest possible value of $a$?

A property owner wants to find the length $x$, in feet, across a pond as represented in the figure. $\overline{PR}$ intersects $\overline{ST}$ at point $Q$, and $\angle PTQ$ is congruent to $\angle RSQ$. The lengths represented by $PQ$, $TQ$, $QS$, and $RS$ were determined to be $4{,}200$ feet, $8{,}400$ feet, $1{,}400$ feet, and $1{,}600$ feet, respectively. What is the value of $x$?

figures.alt: Two triangles meeting at Q. Segments PR and ST cross at Q. Triangle PTQ on the left (P top, T bottom, dashed arc from P to T marked 'x feet', angle at T marked) and triangle RSQ on the right (S top, R bottom, angle at S marked). Labels: PQ = 4,200; TQ = 8,400; QS = 1,400; RS = 1,600. Note under the figure: not drawn to scale.

questions.stem:
The population P of a certain city $y$ years after the last census is modeled by the equation below, where $r$ is a constant and $P_0$ is the population when $y=0$.
$$P=P_0(1+r)^y$$
If during this time the population of the city decreases by a fixed percent each year, which of the following must be true?

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|}\hline x & p(x)\\\hline -2 & 5\\\hline -1 & 0\\\hline 0 & -3\\\hline 1 & -1\\\hline 2 & 0\\\hline\end{array}$$

The table above gives selected values of a polynomial function $p$. Based on the values in the table, which of the following must be a factor of $p$?
Which shaded region represents the solutions to the inequality $y<-60x+50$?

figures.alt: All four source option graphs A–D, preserving shading, dashed or solid boundaries and axis labels.

questions.stem: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x)=56(0.19)^x$. For any positive integer $n$, the value of $f(n)$ is $p\%$ less than the value of $f(n-1)$. What is the value of $p$?

A painting studio is offering a promotion where the first class is free, the second class is half off the regular price, and the remaining classes are regularly priced. If the regular price of a class is \$26.40, which function $f$ gives the total cost, in dollars, of $x$ classes taken using this promotion, where $x\geq2$?
